texture_style: Seamless tileable game texture, perfectly flat orthographic view straight on, no perspective, no horizon, no vanishing point, even flat lighting, no cast shadows, no vignette. Flat illustrated 2D game art in muted riso print colours: flat fills with small hand-drawn marks one value step off the fill, low contrast, calm. No text, no letters, no border, no frame.
texture_avoid: perspective, 3d render, photo, photorealistic, depth of field, shadows, vignette, objects, characters, text, watermark, high contrast, noise, saturated red, saturated blue
prop_style: A single game prop sprite, isometric 2:1 three-quarter view from above, standing alone in the centre on a plain flat cream background (#eae8d6) with nothing else in frame and no ground. Light from upper left. Warm dark outline #373335 around the silhouette. Flat illustrated 2D game art, flat fills with one light band, small marks, muted palette of sage green, moss, warm gray stone, dark teal pine, cream.
prop_avoid: multiple objects, ground plane, floor, grass patch, cast shadow on background, scenery, characters, text, watermark, black outline, photo, 3d render, saturated red, saturated blue
